title: Paging ScrollView: Choosing the Target Page
hints: Convert the offset to a fractional page position first.
Fast flicks move one page in the flick direction; slow releases snap to the nearest page.
jsBridge: Choosing the target page from release offset and velocity is what a paging scroll behaviour computes. CSS `scroll-snap` decides it for you on the web, while a custom `ScrollTargetBehavior` lets you write the rule.
